passage:
**Building permit applications at a town engineering office, January to April 2025**

| Month | Received | Approved |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| January | 40 | 30 |
| February | 50 | 40 |
| March | 60 | 45 |
| April | 80 | 72 |
stem: Each application was either approved or turned down in the same month it was received. From January to April, how many of the applications received were not approved?
hints: For each month, the applications not approved are the ones received minus the ones approved.
Find the number not approved in each month, January to April.
Add the four monthly numbers. To check, add each column, then subtract the Approved total from the Received total.

solution.methodName: Find the values, then add or subtract

steps.why: Check with the column totals: 230 received − 187 approved = 43.

trapNotes.35: This leaves out April (8). Add all four months, January to April.
trapNotes.187: This is the total number approved (30 + 40 + 45 + 72). The question asks for the ones not approved.
trapNotes.230: This is the total number received. Subtract the approved ones to find how many were not approved.
